questions.stem: Erythematous patch with active border at left groin.Which is test for diagnosis?
questions.explanation: Erythematous patch + active border (tinea) ตรวจ KOH

option_why.A: Gram stain ไม่ใช่
option_why.B: ✓ KOH ย้อมเห็น hyphae
option_why.C: Wood's lamp บางชนิด

questions.key_concept:
• tinea: KOH hyphae
• Wood's lamp: Microsporum (บาง), erythrasma
• Tzanck: HSV/VZV
